title: CDC Coops Videos | Healthy Pets, Healthy People | CDC
content: April 12, 2024 CDC Coops Videos What to know Many people keep backyard poultry for fun, eggs, and education. CDC toured unique backyard coops and spoke to poultry owners to understand how they stay healthy around their birds. Watch the videos below to see the coops and learn some healthy tips. Episode 1: Doja Chick Do you know how to clean eggs from your backyard flock? Watch the video to learn how and see if you spot a chicken named Doug. Low Resolution Video Episode 2: Chick Inn This chicken owner has a whole Inn for her hens. Watch the video for tips on how to stay healthy with your birds. See if you spot a guest appearance you may not expect (Hen Solo).
